steps.eval: (() => { const first = document.querySelector('#board .tile:not(:disabled)'); const row = first.dataset.row; const letter = first.textContent; first.click(); const next = [...document.querySelectorAll('#board .tile:not(:disabled)')].find(b => b.dataset.row !== row && b.textContent !== letter); if (!next) throw new Error('No second trade tile'); next.click(); })()
